visualCharacteristics.structure: heading + text + field + button + list + link + image
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Contact, consultation, sponsorship, newsletter and gated-content forms with optional intro copy or advisor profiles

contentPattern.structure: Any number of intro rows (heading, text, lists, advisor photos/contacts; each cell becomes an intro part) plus one row whose only content is a link to the form source. A link to a .json spreadsheet (columns Name, Label, Type, Placeholder, Mandatory, Options, Value; Type text/email/tel/number/date/textarea/select/checkbox/radio/hidden/heading/plaintext/submit) renders a native form that POSTs {data} to the sheet path; any other link (Moosend, Dynamics or other hosted form) is embedded in an iframe

usage: Use for any on-page form: the advisor contact/consultation form (intro above, or beside it with text-left), community sponsorship requests (boxed), newsletter subscriptions (boxed-3) and gated downloads (boxed-2). The source forms are Sitecore Forms, Moosend and Dynamics Marketing; recreate fields in a .json sheet or link the hosted form URL.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for every form-style section; pick text-left when intro copy or advisor profiles sit beside the form, dark for dark-background sections, boxed/boxed-2/boxed-3 for panelled forms. Search/filter UIs on listing pages (A-Z filters) are not forms to author; they need a dedicated listing block.
